title: 鈷與釕互連研究
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究尺度與材料、整合路線、電阻與介面、可靠度比較；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: scaling and materials, integration routes, resistance and interfaces, reliability comparison. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 建立相同有效截面的公平基準
steps.titleEn: Build a fair benchmark at matched conducting area
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：名目線寬相同未必導電面積相同。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Equal nominal width need not mean equal conducting area.
steps.instruction:
建立相同有效截面的公平基準。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。完成一頁審查紀錄，列出接受條件、證據缺口與不應外推的範圍。最後以「名目線寬相同未必導電面積相同。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：以同一外框 20×30 nm² 比較假想材料。Cu 有兩側與底部 3 nm 襯層，導電面積 14×27=378 nm²，有效ρ=4 μΩ·cm；無襯層候選金屬面積600 nm²、有效ρ=6 μΩ·cm。相同線長下比較 ρ/A，比例為 (6/600)/(4/378)=0.945；較高ρ的候選反而低阻約5.5%。這不證明無襯層可靠，須另驗證擴散與附著。
steps.instructionEn:
Build a fair benchmark at matched conducting area. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Complete a one-page review listing acceptance criteria, evidence gaps and limits on extrapolation. Finally check your inference against this principle: Equal nominal width need not mean equal conducting area.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Compare hypothetical materials in the same 20×30 nm² footprint. Cu has 3 nm side/bottom liners, conducting area 14×27=378 nm² and effective ρ=4 μΩ·cm. A linerless candidate has area 600 nm² and effective ρ=6 μΩ·cm. At equal length, resistance ratio is (6/600)/(4/378)=0.945: the higher-ρ candidate is about 5.5% lower in resistance. This does not prove linerless reliability; diffusion and adhesion need separate tests.
